name: v0.122.0
body:
## What



Read the [complete changes for v0.122.0](https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/blob/v0.122.0/CHANGELOG.md). The full changelog is preserved in this release's source tree; the pull request index follows below.

## Install

```sh
brew install supernovae-st/tap/nika          # macOS · Linux
curl -LsSf https://nika.sh/install.sh | sh   # script install
docker run --rm ghcr.io/supernovae-st/nika:0.122.0 --version
```

Tarballs below: macOS arm64 / x64 · Linux x64 / arm64, plus `SHA256SUMS`.

## Verify: three independent proofs

```sh
# 1 · checksum: the bytes you hold are the bytes CI hashed
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing     # macOS: shasum -a 256 -c

# 2 · attestation: GitHub-signed build provenance for this exact artifact
gh attestation verify nika-<platform>-0.122.0.tar.gz --repo supernovae-st/nika

# 3 · SLSA provenance: the intoto asset, verifiable offline
slsa-verifier verify-artifact nika-<platform>-0.122.0.tar.gz \
  --provenance-path multiple.intoto.jsonl \
  --source-uri github.com/supernovae-st/nika --source-tag v0.122.0
```

## Provenance

Built from tag `v0.122.0` by [`release.yml`](https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/blob/v0.122.0/.github/workflows/release.yml)
on GitHub-hosted runners. Provenance is published twice: GitHub's native
build attestation (proof 2) and the SLSA generator's `multiple.intoto.jsonl`
release asset (proof 3). The release itself is a claim on the
machine-verified timeline: https://nika.sh/timeline


## What's Changed
* feat(media): rebuild the readme film and every clip on one engine by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1748
* feat(media): four new clips and a readme for people meeting nika by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1750
* feat(media): the session, cost, approval and typescript clips by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1751
* feat: compose grounded authoring, session recovery and run authority by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1747
* feat: stabilize native authoring and rehearsed copy proposals by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1753
* Rehearse native proposals before consent by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1756
* Patch the media dependency and clarify verification notes by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1757
* chore(release): prepare 0.122.0 by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1758


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/compare/v0.121.0...v0.122.0
